_comment: UNC Mockup Reveal Scripts v1 — for prospects we already built a free working homepage mockup for. Every prospect loaded into this cockpit has a mockup_url; the entire script IS the mockup pitch.

greeting.no_contact_default: Hey — is the owner around? Quick call about {business_name}.

word_for_word.label: Word for Word
word_for_word.script: Hey {first_name} — {rep_name} calling, Urban Niche Co. Straight up, this is a cold call — but I did more than homework. I actually built {business_name} a free, working homepage. No charge, no catch. Want me to send you the link right now so you can see it?

guided.label: Guided
anchors: Say it's a cold call — upfront, always
"I built {business_name} a free working homepage" — this is proof, not a promise
Ask permission to send the link. That's the whole ask.

freestyle.label: Freestyle
freestyle.goal: Get them to look at the mockup. That's the entire call.
reminders: Lead with the cold call declaration
The mockup is the hook — you already did the work, that's rare and it lands
Ask for the best way to send it (text or email), then stop talking

opener.training_note: This is the strongest opener in the playbook — you're not selling an idea, you're handing over a finished thing. Say 'I built' not 'I designed a concept' — built means done. Send the link fast, while they're still curious.

YES_SEND_IT.label: Yes — send it over
YES_SEND_IT.script: Perfect. Best number to text it to, or you want it by email? {mockup_url} — take a look when you get a sec, no pressure. If you like what you see, call me back, or I'll follow up in a couple days.
YES_SEND_IT.training_note: Get the send method confirmed out loud, then get off the phone. The mockup does the selling from here — don't over-talk it.

WHY_FREE.label: Why would you do this for free?
WHY_FREE.script: Because I only work with contractors, and most of you don't have a real website to show people — I'd rather hand you something than describe it. Costs you nothing to look. If you hate it, you've lost 30 seconds.
WHY_FREE.training_note: This objection means they're interested but suspicious — normal. Answer it once, plainly, then get back to sending the link.

ALREADY_HAVE_SITE.label: I already have a website
ALREADY_HAVE_SITE.script: Didn't think so when I built this — I do this for guys who don't have one yet. If I've got bad info, tell me your site and I'll take a real look instead. Otherwise, want to see what I built?
ALREADY_HAVE_SITE.training_note: Confirm/deny fast, don't get defensive. If they do have a real site, quietly route the rest of this call back to the standard cold-call flow.

NOT_INTERESTED.label: Not interested
NOT_INTERESTED.script: Fair enough. It's already built and sitting there either way — want the link so it's in your pocket if you change your mind? Zero effort on your end.
NOT_INTERESTED.training_note: The ask costs them nothing, so 'not interested' rarely survives a second, lower-pressure offer of the same thing.

BUSY_NOW.label: Busy / bad time
BUSY_NOW.script: No problem — ten seconds: I built {business_name} a free website mockup, already done. Want me to text you the link so you can look whenever?
BUSY_NOW.training_note: Busy is not a no. The ask is small enough to survive almost any 'not now.'

post_reveal_pitch._note: Use on the FOLLOW-UP call after they've already seen the mockup — this is where 'calling' turns into 'pitching.'
post_reveal_pitch.script: Hey {first_name} — did you get a chance to look at the mockup I built for {business_name}? That's a preview, not the finished product — I can have the real thing live in about 14 days. Want me to walk you through what that looks like?
post_reveal_pitch.training_note: If yes, route straight into pitch_30 / trade_specific — the audit_offer becomes a proposal ask instead, since they've already seen proof. Move fast, don't re-sell what already sold them.
